## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes.
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes locally.
- [ ] `python -m ruff check .` passes locally.
- [ ] `python -m ruff format --check .` passes locally.
- [ ] Policy impact reviewed.
- [ ] Approval workflow impact reviewed.
- [ ] Audit logging and redaction impact reviewed.
- [ ] Workspace boundary impact reviewed.
- [ ] Docs or examples updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] No real personal data, API keys, tokens, credentials, or private files added.

## Notes

Mention any remaining risks, limitations, or follow-up work.
